vgc-seo.name: VGC SEO
vgc-seo.details: Titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph, schema and XML sitemaps. Imports your AIOSEO settings so the output stays the same.

vgc-stats.name: VGC Stats
vgc-stats.description: Cookieless visitor statistics and the shop funnel.
vgc-stats.details: Cookieless analytics: visits, sources and pages, plus the WooCommerce funnel from product view to order. It sets no cookies, so it needs no consent banner.

vgc-newsletter.name: Newsletter
vgc-newsletter.description: Send newsletters from your own site, in batches.
vgc-newsletter.details: Write or paste a newsletter and send it from your own site to your subscribers, in batches your host accepts. Reports, templates and subscriber lists included.

vgc-cookie-compliance.name: Cookie Compliance
vgc-cookie-compliance.description: Finds every cookie your site sets, with a consent banner.
vgc-cookie-compliance.details: Finds every cookie and storage item your site sets and records what you decide about each one. The consent banner holds back what needs consent until people agree.

vgc-order-withdrawal.name: Order Withdrawal
vgc-order-withdrawal.description: EU 14-day withdrawal requests, with guest links.
vgc-order-withdrawal.details: Customers withdraw from an order within 14 days, as EU law requires. Guests get a magic link, and you handle every request in one inbox.

vgc-email-templates.name: Email Templates
vgc-email-templates.details: Designs the WooCommerce and WordPress emails in one builder, with your logo, colours and footer.

vgc-speedy.name: Speedy
vgc-speedy.description: Waybills, offices, cash on delivery and delivery status.
vgc-speedy.details: Creates Speedy waybills from orders, lets customers pick a Speedy office at checkout, handles cash on delivery and shows each parcel's delivery status.

vgc-google-product-feed.name: Google Product Feed
vgc-google-product-feed.description: A Merchant Center feed of your products.
vgc-google-product-feed.details: Publishes your WooCommerce products as a Google Merchant Center feed.

vgc-events-for-woocommerce.name: Events for WooCommerce
vgc-events-for-woocommerce.description: Event tickets, check-in and ticket templates.
vgc-events-for-woocommerce.details: Sells event tickets as WooCommerce products, with check-in at the door and ticket templates.

vgc-price-by-quantity.name: Price by Quantity
vgc-price-by-quantity.details: Tiered unit prices: the more someone buys, the lower the price per item.
vgc-price-by-quantity.where: It works on the product edit screen.

vgc-limited-editions.name: Limited Editions
vgc-limited-editions.details: Numbers each item in a limited series, such as 12 of 50.
vgc-limited-editions.where: It works on the product edit screen.

vgc-trash-guard.name: Trash Guard
vgc-trash-guard.description: Asks before anything is trashed or deleted, and logs it.
vgc-trash-guard.details: A popup names the item and what depends on it (bookings, open orders, the front page) and waits for a second click before anything goes to the trash or is deleted for good. One switch turns trashing off for everyone; the trash log shows who did what.
